source.title: Marene - Roaring Tempest
source.name: Marene
source.description: A hotheaded Mage who unleashes raging storms to vanquish her enemies.

skills.name: Storm's Wrath

description.raw: Marene soars into the air and summons a storm that lasts for 4s. It immediately deals damage to all enemies equal to 30% + 3% (SP-based) of their HP, up to 500% + 50% (SP-based) of her ATK. While the storm is active, Marene continuously knocks all enemies into the air, reducing their Ranged DEF by 20. Additionally, Marene activates Tempest Eye 2 times per second, calling down lightning strikes that deal 110% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) true damage to all enemies. The activation frequency scales with her Haste, up to a maximum of 8 activations per second. Marene remains invincible when casting this skill.

Marene remains invincible when casting this skill.

skills.name: Gathering Gale

description.raw: Passive. Marene amplifies the Haste buffs her allies grant her by 100% and retains the Haste gained even after those buffs expire. Haste bonuses from the same buff do not stack. Active. Marene channels her Tempest Eye for 2s, activating it 2 times per second. Each activation generates a small gust of wind at an enemy's position, dealing 110% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to enemies within 1 tile of the target. Targets are selected from front to back, prioritizing different enemies. The activation frequency scales with her Haste, up to a maximum of 8 activations per second.

skills.name: Twin Cyclone

description.raw: Marene conjures 2 clusters of wind blades and launches them at the nearest and farthest enemies, respectively. The blades circle and slash at their targets for 2s, dealing 110% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to the targets and enemies within 2 tiles of them every 0.5s.

skills.name: Aeon Tempest

description.raw: When the Haste bonus Marene gains from allies reaches 60, she enters Windborne state, becoming steadfast and taking 45% less damage and ignoring 45% of enemies' Ranged DEF when dealing damage. Once her Tempest Eye has activated 30 times, she unleashes a massive thunderstorm that permanently covers the battlefield. It deals 110% (ATK-based) true damage to all enemies every second and unleashes powerful gusts every 5s that knock all enemies into the air and destroy all obstacles.
